note: The fixture pair for pool-exhaustion (L08 in fixtures/PLAN.md), Fastify and pg, a pool of 5 form, scanned with pool-exhaustion alone. Written by hand: each planted defect is fixed in place in the clean twin, line for line, and the twins differ in nothing else. A finding catches a defect when its check matches and its locations name the defect's file, line, column and symbol (every place, when the defect lists several), with the defect's severity. Decoys are in both twins; reporting one is a false positive. The auto fixes for a missing release wrap the code after the checkout in try with the release in finally, so the clean twin's reports.js and imports.js are longer than the planted ones; the guided fixes move a call before the checkout, and list every line from one to the other. Paths are relative to each twin. Nothing here is installed or run.
